Class PasskeyCredentialRepository

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.security.passkey.PasskeyCredentialRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.security.web.webauthn.management.UserCredentialRepository
Direct Known Subclasses:
PasskeyCredentialRepository.Registration, PasskeyCredentialRepository.SignIn
public abstract sealed class PasskeyCredentialRepository extends Object implements org.springframework.security.web.webauthn.management.UserCredentialRepository permits PasskeyCredentialRepository.Registration, PasskeyCredentialRepository.SignIn
The credential store of the relying party operations over user_passkey. The library calls UserCredentialRepository.save(CredentialRecord) for a new credential and again after every verified assertion; the two views below give that call its meaning. The registration view inserts. The sign-in view only updates the usage, enforcing the signature counter, and refuses when no row changed.
